annotations.title: New manga licenses in English by year

description: Manga series whose first English edition comes out in a year: English publisher, first volume, its date and status in Japan, in date order. A series counts in the year its first English book holding volume 1 comes out. The date is that book's release date, not the day a license was announced. Defaults to this year.

year.description: The year, like 2026. Default this year (UTC).
